label: a merchant in day dress in an American town, mid 1830s
note: Gathered 2026-11-07 for T-3449, the 1835 merchant's day dress first worn by Philip F. W. Peck. None is of Chicago or of Peck: a British coat and trousers of about 1833 on a form (the Met, in colour), Durand's 1835 portrait of the New York merchant Luman Reed, and Hornor's 1836 Broadway at street distance. A reference set says what a man of this role and decade looked like, never what Peck wore on a given day.

pictures.name: met_1833_tailcoat
pictures.from: Met open-access image DT412 (2867 x 3722), crop [820, 150, 2150, 3700], the dressed form, reduced to 1600 high
pictures.caption: Coat and trousers, British, ca. 1833, with waistcoat and stock. The Met, Costume Institute 1981.210.4 and 1982.316.11
pictures.shows: The whole outfit from the front three-quarter: blue tailcoat cut square at the waist with a dark velvet collar and covered buttons, buff waistcoat, black stock tied in a bow, full pleated pale linen trousers strapped under black shoes.

pictures.name: durand_1835_reed
pictures.from: Met open-access image ap63.36 (1879 x 2320), the whole portrait, reduced to 1600 high
pictures.caption: Asher B. Durand, Luman Reed, 1835. The Met 63.36
pictures.shows: A New York merchant at about a metre, to the waist: black coat with a high rolled collar, a wide black stock under the jaw, white shirt collar points at the cheeks, a white shirt front, short side whiskers.

pictures.name: hornor_1836_broadway
pictures.from: Met open-access image 49H_116R3 (3337 x 2475), crop [150, 1450, 1000, 1980], the west sidewalk, at full resolution
pictures.caption: Thomas Hornor, Broadway, New-York, 1836, the west sidewalk. The Met 54.90.703
pictures.shows: Men and women on the sidewalk at street distance: a man in a blue tailcoat, black top hat and white trousers in the middle of the walk, others in top hats beyond; at this size a tailcoat reads as a dark body over pale legs under a tall black hat.
